entities.summary: Jadier Valladares Guzmán is a male weightlifter from Cuba. He twice won a gold medal at the Pan American Games for his native South American country. Valladares represented Cuba at the 2008 Summer Olympics in Beijing, PR China. Jadier Valladares was a athletes & competitors from Havana (b. 1982-10-11, Havana). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
